subject: Appeal: short sandbox stipend while SFTP adapter is blocked
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@shiply.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@shiply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Appeal: short sandbox stipend while SFTP adapter is blocked

Hi Samira / Alex,

Quick note from my side — Shiply's SFTP adapter hit an unexpected blocker during the connector handoff this morning (engineering traced it to a config mismatch when the partner cert rotates). Your team is blocked on end-to-end testing and the demo window is next Wednesday.

To keep momentum on the POC and avoid losing the demo slot, would you consider a small one-time sandbox stipend (credits) while we work with you on the adapter fix? The ask is to cover token usage for two weeks of integration testing (we estimate ~3k credits).

I attached the initial error log from our runner for context. If you can give a ballpark yes/no today, I can get the legal / billing sign-off queued.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

[attachment: sftp-error-log.txt (text) referenced]

From: Samira Khan <samira@shiply.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@shiply.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:45:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Appeal: short sandbox stipend while SFTP adapter is blocked

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the heads up and the log. We saw the same TLS handshake failures on our side earlier today. Our infra lead (Alex) is looking into whether this is a cert rotation or a path permission issue.

Before we escalate to procurement, can you outline:
- Exact credit amount you suggest and how you translate that to your billing unit (credits vs tokens).
- Whether this is a refundable/conditional stipend (we prefer time-limited credits rather than discounts).

I can push for an internal quick approval if the ask is modest. We want to avoid creating extra procurement work for a small operational fix.

Samira
Head of Platform, Shiply
samira@shiply.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:05:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Appeal: short sandbox stipend while SFTP adapter is blocked

Lauren,

Thanks for flagging — saw the log, and dug in with the serving team. Quick internal options and recommended ask:

- Recommended stipend: 5,000 credits (one-time). That buys Shiply ~2 weeks of aggressive integration testing and small end-to-end regressions on our hosted POC environment.
- Reason: covers estimated token generation + additional smoke tests. We prefer a one-time credit (time-limited, expires in 30 days) rather than an open discount.
- Risk: low; if adapter still fails we can pause the credits and revisit after root cause.

Attachments: manifest-diff.json (shows config delta), runbook-snapshot.pdf (quick steps we will take with Shiply).

If you want, I can present this to David for an expedited approve/decline — should be a quick exec trade-off.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

[attachments: manifest-diff.json, runbook-snapshot.pdf]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@shiply.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@shiply.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Appeal: short sandbox stipend while SFTP adapter is blocked

Approved.

I reviewed Marissa's recommendation and the attached diffs — approving a one-time 5,000-credit sandbox stipend for Shiply, valid for 30 days from issuance. Please document the credit in HubSpot (SH-4621) and mark the funding reason as "integration unblock - SFTP adapter".

Marissa — please coordinate with billing to issue the credits and confirm with Shiply once applied. Lauren — keep me in the loop if the demo date slips; we can consider an incremental extension but prefer to keep it to this one-time grant.

Thanks everyone for the quick triage.

—
David Kim
Director, Sales Engineering
david_kim@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
